evidence.quote: 12. Production Comment Log Record any comments or observations from the production process. Initial and date each comment. Quality Assurance shall review, initial and date each comment or observation following production.
evidence.reason: The section provides fields to record comments, initials, and dates for production steps, qualifying as a process execution record.
